newsitem.title: USA: Dow opens solidly higher, pushed up by IBM.
newsitem.headline: Dow opens solidly higher, pushed up by IBM.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened higher on Monday, pushed up by oil stocks and strength in IBM, which jumped 1-1/8 at the opening to 116-3/8 before settling back to 115-7/8.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 23 to 5,683, while the NASDAQ Index was up three to 1,142 and the S&P Index up two to 658.
New York Stock Exchange advances led declines by 676 to 307, while NASDAQ advances outpaced declines by 978/657.
The long bond was up 3/32 to yield 7.10 percent.
